system.description: As a reaction when one of your allies within your movement speed range is targeted by an attack or forced to make a saving throw, you can spend a superiority die to swap places with them, becoming the new target of the attack or forcing you to make the saving throw. You may add half of the superiority die result as a bonus to both your own and the allied creatures AC and saving throws against the triggering effect, until the end of the current turn.
